meta.parties: The Ceylon Land and Produce Co. Ltd. v. Malcolmson

rules.statement: An action quia timet is maintainable in Ceylon, provided there is actual or imminent injury and prospective damage of a substantial nature.
rules.supporting_quote: "The existence of such a deed on the register, said that learned Judge, in language that may fitly be applied to the present case, 'would necessarily 1 (1886) 7 S. C. C. 145. 2 (1901) 2 Tambiah 73. 19 prejudice the plaintiff. It would render his share in the land unsale able and valueless, because no one would purchase from him or would lend money to him on that security until his title on the register was cleared."
